description: AGSC-09-94 with AGSC-09-10; supersedes cli-0013. run and trace have no effect unless run.enabled is true, and with it false (the default of AGSC-01-18) both exit 2 with AGSC-E004 — a configuration the tool cannot run against, AGSC-09-08's exit-2 class — and no run block is read. Derivation: the verb is one of the sixteen, so AGSC-E001 (unknown verb) cannot name the fault; the refusal comes from the configuration, which is what AGSC-E004 is registered for. Under --json, AGSC-09-10 requires exactly one JCS-canonical envelope on stdout except where exit 2 is reached before a verb is resolved (an unknown verb or flag) or an internal fault has no registered code; neither holds here, so stdout carries the envelope (verb named, status fail, the one AGSC-E004 finding) and stderr the same finding as one JSON object. The minimal fixture carries no run block, so run.enabled is false by default. cli-0013 expected an empty stdout and is withdrawn.
